snippet.title: The Tale of Mara & Moa | Steam, PS4/5, Xbox One/Series X|S and Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
#QUByteConnect2025

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2711650/The_Tale_of_Mara__Moa/

Mara and Moa have made a terrible mistake and now they need to find the Spirits of the Forest to save their village. Explore a world full of secrets with dynamic and fast-paced combat, alternating between the two characters and channeling the powers of the Sun and the Moon.
